weather.label: Prepare
weather.summary: Tropical Storm Alma approaching NW Bahamas. Sustained winds 45-55 kt. Storm surge 2-4 ft possible on north shore. NHC track cone includes New Providence.

institutional.headline: Flash Update: Tropical system may disrupt health transport in Nassau metro
institutional.summary: OCHA notes dialysis and oncology patients at elevated risk if bridge closures occur. Coordination with local NEMT operators recommended.

institutional.headline: Paradise Island bridge corridor flagged in regional exposure index
institutional.summary: Historical flood exposure on Eastern Road low segment correlates with prior storm washouts. Monitor CORR-01 and CORR-02 status.
